reply: -in-t slope is about 0.47 and independent of P, and the t² coefficient multiplies P^1.5 (free-exponent fit gave 1.4999). The remaining P-dependence is a mix of 1/P, P lnP, lnP, and several powers of P whose coefficients trade off against each other, so the true functional form is still unidentified.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    return (params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*t*t*P**1.5 + params[3]/P
            + params[4]*P*np.log(P) + params[5]*P + params[6]*P*P + params[7]*P**3
            + params[8]*np.log(P) + params[9]*P**1.5)
